_comment: Enterprise white-label brand template. Fill in and save as {client-cuid}.json, then upload to S3 at branding/{client-cuid}.json. Only identity + colors.primary (+ optional colors.secondary) are used. Colors are HSL: h = 0-360, s and l = percentages as strings. primary drives buttons, active states, icons and accents in both light and dark mode; secondary is the optional accent/highlight color. primaryHex is the same brand color as a hex string, used for the installed-app (PWA) theme color and emails.
